components.gap: owned by w02c-p15-014: Supply with thm:p15-levy-information-law the continuation of the source's Theorem 4.6.9 that the entry cites ('thm. 4.6.9 and continuation'; Durrett 2019, pp. 247-248): the source's two readings of Levy's 0-1 law, 'it is obvious' (since 1_A is F_infinity-measurable and F_n increases to F_infinity, the best guess E(1_A|F_n) of 1_A given F_n should approach 1_A, the best guess given F_infinity) and 'it is incredible' (for a tail event of independent variables every E(1_A|F_n) equals the constant P(A), yet the limit is 1_A, which forces P(A) in {0,1}, Kolmogorov's 0-1 law), with the source's point that the one theorem supports both views (and its closing remark that this and later applications show the theorem is very useful). On the route (body lines 161-176, annex 287-305) only the formal statement, the Kolmogorov corollary and their proofs are supplied; the two readings and their contrast are absent.
